text.en: Swin UNETR is row 100 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Detection Segmentation area.
text.zh: Swin UNETR 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 100 行，所属领域为“检测与分割”。

text.en: The annual table associates Swin UNETR with “Swin UNETR: Swin Transformers for Semantic Segmentation of Brain Tumors in MRI Images”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Swin UNETR 与论文《Swin UNETR: Swin Transformers for Semantic Segmentation of Brain Tumors in MRI Images》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Ali Hatamizadeh, Daguang Xu”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Ali Hatamizadeh（官方页拼写）、Daguang Xu（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Ali Hatamizadeh, Daguang Xu”。
